findings: Literal `RUST_GUIDELINES.md:59` (`No absolute paths.`) compliance is restored in `crates/mori/tests/init.rs:328-342,365` (`proposal/a1-to-a2.patch` `eb9994fe...`). Instead of a1's hardcoded `"/bin/sh"`, the test inspects `std::env::var_os("PATH")` via `std::env::split_paths`, selects the first `sh` where `fs::metadata` reports `is_file()` and mode `& 0o111 != 0`, and calls `fs::canonicalize` before `c.current_dir(&dir)` and `.env("PATH", "")`. Canonicalizing prior to changing `current_dir` ensures relative host `PATH` entries still resolve after `current_dir(&dir)` with an empty child `PATH`. In `init.rs:106`, `std::env::current_exe()` is runtime-derived rather than a hardcoded source path.

Public CLI dispatch and local reference consumer contracts match across `crates/mori/src/commands/init.rs:50,92-94,103-112` and `crates/mori/src/commands/{mod,check,simulate,test}.rs`. `init::Args` (`init.rs:11-19`) is unchanged and `project()` (`init.rs:50`) remains private. The generated `README.md` commands invoke `{executable} check source.mori --json` (`check.rs:29-49` -> `status: "accepted"`, `language: "moriarty/1"`), `{executable} simulate source.mori --action {action} --scenario scenario.json` (`simulate.rs:109-147` -> `status: "accepted"`, `qualification: "local-reference-execution"`, `execution.semantics: "moriarty-core/1"`), and `{executable} test .` (`test.rs:40-88` -> `status: "passed"`, full `post` and `effects` equality).

Pre-reservation error handling in `crates/mori/src/commands/init.rs:106-117` preserves atomic destination refusal. `std::env::current_exe()` and `.to_str()` UTF-8 validation report errors via `super::core_io::operation` (`core_io.rs:158-164`) and `project(args.template, &executable)?` completes all in-memory serialization before `std::fs::create_dir(&args.dir)` (`init.rs:114`) and `OpenOptions::new().write(true).create_new(true)` (`init.rs:120-123`). Any failure in executable resolution or UTF-8 conversion leaves the target path untouched.

Portability and host prerequisites in `crates/mori/src/commands/init.rs:93,106-110` and `crates/mori/tests/init.rs:197-206,325-395`: embedding the single-quoted creating executable path prevents `PATH` collisions with another `mori` binary, and `README.md:93` explicitly scopes the commands to a POSIX shell and notes the path must be updated if the binary moves. Cross-platform tests (`tests/init.rs:128-229,251-323`) remain portable because `tests/init.rs:197-206` compares two `init` runs from the same `CARGO_BIN_EXE_mori` binary. The `#[cfg(unix)]` regression (`tests/init.rs:325-395`) requires the test host `PATH` to provide an executable `sh` file before clearing child `PATH`.
